dialogues.jp:
帰り道、公園の前を通り過ぎようとした俺はふ
と、足をとめた。
dialogues.en:
Passing through a park on the way home, my steady walk
quickly came to a halt.
dialogues.text:
Passing through a park on the way home, my steady walk
quickly came to a halt.

dialogues.jp: ……なにやら見慣れた制服姿がふたり。
dialogues.en: ...My eyes had fallen over a couple in familiar uniforms.
dialogues.text: ...My eyes had fallen over a couple in familiar uniforms.

dialogues.jp: 風見学園本校男子＆付属女子の姿だった。
dialogues.en:
The Kazami Academy main school boy's uniform, and the
attached school's girl's uniform.
dialogues.text:
The Kazami Academy main school boy's uniform, and the
attached school's girl's uniform.

dialogues.jp: その、男子のほうの顔を見て、おや？　と思う。
dialogues.en:
I was slightly surprised as I got a better look at the
male's face.
dialogues.text:
I was slightly surprised as I got a better look at the
male's face.

dialogues.jp: （あれは…………工藤じゃないか）
dialogues.en: "(That's... Kudou, isn't it.)"
dialogues.text: "(That's... Kudou, isn't it.)"

dialogues.jp:
我らが悪友仲間工藤は、見知らぬ付属の女子と
ともに滑り台のそばに｛たたず／佇｝んでいる。
dialogues.en:
One of my "worst friends", and an unknown girl from the
attached school, were standing beside the playground slide.
dialogues.text:
One of my "worst friends", and an unknown girl from the
attached school, were standing beside the playground slide.

dialogues.jp: 「さすが美少年、絵になるねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"He's really a bishounen, the scene looks like it was lifted
from a painting."
dialogues.text:
"He's really a bishounen, the scene looks like it was lifted
from a painting."

dialogues.jp: ムードのある空気がそこいらに漂っている。
dialogues.en: A similar mood was drifting about in the air.
dialogues.text: A similar mood was drifting about in the air.

dialogues.jp: ふむ。
dialogues.en: Hmm.
dialogues.text: Hmm.

dialogues.jp:
俺はひとまず近くの木陰に身をひそめ、事の成
り行きを見守ることにした。
dialogues.en:
I took cover behind a nearby tree, and continued my
reconaissance.
dialogues.text:
I took cover behind a nearby tree, and continued my
reconaissance.

dialogues.jp:
頬を染めた女の子は、こちらの方がどきどきし
てしまうくらい緊張しているようだった。
dialogues.en:
The girl was blushing heavily, and fidgeting with
nervousness.
dialogues.text:
The girl was blushing heavily, and fidgeting with
nervousness.

dialogues.jp: 「さすが下級生、初々しいやね……」
dialogues.en: "That's a real lowerclasswoman, she looks so innocent..."
dialogues.text: "That's a real lowerclasswoman, she looks so innocent..."

dialogues.jp: しかも、なかなか可愛い子だ。
dialogues.en: Moreover, she's pretty cute as well.
dialogues.text: Moreover, she's pretty cute as well.

dialogues.jp:
しばらく沈黙が続いたが、彼女はためらいがち
に、それでも――思い切ったように口を開く。
dialogues.en:
The silence continued for a short while, as the girl
hesitated slightly-- then finally opened her mouth.
dialogues.text:
The silence continued for a short while, as the girl
hesitated slightly-- then finally opened her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「工藤先輩……わたし、ずっと先輩のことが好
　きでした……」
dialogues.en: "Kudou-senpai... I've always liked you..."
dialogues.text: "Kudou-senpai... I've always liked you..."

dialogues.jp:
その語尾は恥ずかしそうに震えて消える。でも、
確かに女の子はついに、自分の気持ちを伝えた
のだった。
dialogues.en:
She shivered slightly from embarassment as she finished her
sentence. But the girl continued to convey her feelings.
dialogues.text:
She shivered slightly from embarassment as she finished her
sentence. But the girl continued to convey her feelings.

dialogues.jp: 「よくやった、感動した」
dialogues.en: "Damn, even I'm touched."
dialogues.text: "Damn, even I'm touched."

dialogues.jp:
ひとり腕組みをしつつ物陰でしきりと頷く俺。
はたから見れば単なる変質者かもしれないな。
dialogues.en:
Still behind the tree, I nodded to no one in particular. I
probably look like a horrible person doing this.
dialogues.text:
Still behind the tree, I nodded to no one in particular. I
probably look like a horrible person doing this.

dialogues.jp:
工藤め、｛うらや／羨｝ましい奴。こんな可愛いくて｛ういうい／初々｝し
い子に告白されやがって……。
dialogues.en:
That Kudou, he's so enviable. Having such a cute and
innocent girl confess to him...
dialogues.text:
That Kudou, he's so enviable. Having such a cute and
innocent girl confess to him...

dialogues.jp:
常々彼女が欲しいな〜なんて言っていた俺たち
だが、工藤は早くも一人身脱却か？
dialogues.en:
We've always talked about the pains of not having a
girlfriend, but it looks like Kudou's days of bachelorhood
are ending?...
dialogues.text:
We've always talked about the pains of not having a
girlfriend, but it looks like Kudou's days of bachelorhood
are ending?...

dialogues.jp:
だが、顔を伏せて、呟くように工藤の口から発
せられた言葉は俺の予想していたものとはまっ
たく違うものだった。
dialogues.en:
But, as I turned back and primed my ears again, the words
Kudou uttered were far from what I expected.
dialogues.text:
But, as I turned back and primed my ears again, the words
Kudou uttered were far from what I expected.

dialogues.en: ---Ehhh!?
dialogues.text: ---Ehhh!?

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず身を乗り出した。
dialogues.en: I inadvertently leaned forward further, straining my ears.
dialogues.text: I inadvertently leaned forward further, straining my ears.

dialogues.jp:
何だ？　何て言った？　それとも俺の聞き間違
いなのか！？
dialogues.en: What was that? What did he say? I must've heard wrong!?
dialogues.text: What was that? What did he say? I must've heard wrong!?

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「キミの気持ちはすごく嬉しいんだけど……俺、
　今付き合ってる人がいるから」
dialogues.en:
"I'm very happy to hear your feelings, but... I have someone
right now."
dialogues.text:
"I'm very happy to hear your feelings, but... I have someone
right now."

dialogues.jp:
静かな声で、しかしはっきりと断りの言葉を口
にする工藤。
dialogues.en: His words were soft, yet the rejection was clear as glass.
dialogues.text: His words were soft, yet the rejection was clear as glass.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あ……そ、そう……だったんですか……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I... I see...."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I... I see...."

dialogues.jp: 明らかに動揺する女の子。
dialogues.en: The girl was trembling, on the verge of crying.
dialogues.text: The girl was trembling, on the verge of crying.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: ".........I'm really sorry."
dialogues.text: ".........I'm really sorry."

dialogues.jp: 工藤はもう一度その言葉を繰り返した。
dialogues.en: Kudou repeated his rejection again.
dialogues.text: Kudou repeated his rejection again.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: "I, it's okay......"
dialogues.text: "I, it's okay......"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「わ、わたしこそ……突然呼び出したりして、
　すみませんでした」
dialogues.en: "I, I'm sorry too... for calling you out so abruptly..."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm sorry too... for calling you out so abruptly..."

dialogues.jp:
彼女はぺこりと頭をさげると、涙をふきながら
小走りに去っていった。
dialogues.en:
The girl bowed, then walked away, the tears streaming down
her face visible to all.
dialogues.text:
The girl bowed, then walked away, the tears streaming down
her face visible to all.

dialogues.jp:
俺は女の子の後姿が見えなくなるのを待って、
隠れ場所から姿を現した。
dialogues.en:
I waited until the girl disappeared from my sight, then came
out from my hiding place.
dialogues.text:
I waited until the girl disappeared from my sight, then came
out from my hiding place.

dialogues.jp: 「……お前も罪な奴だな」
dialogues.en: "...You're horrible."
dialogues.text: "...You're horrible."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ朝倉、見てたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Wha, Asakura. You saw that?"
dialogues.text: "Wha, Asakura. You saw that?"

dialogues.jp: ばつが悪そうに振り向く工藤。
dialogues.en: My immediate attack quickly turned him around.
dialogues.text: My immediate attack quickly turned him around.

dialogues.jp:
「……なんで断ったりしたんだよ。付き合って
　る奴がいる、なんて嘘だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Why did you reject her? You lied about having someone
right now, didn't you?"
dialogues.text:
"...Why did you reject her? You lied about having someone
right now, didn't you?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は真っ先にその疑問をぶつけた。
dialogues.en: I went straight for the heart of the matter.
dialogues.text: I went straight for the heart of the matter.

dialogues.jp:
こいつは独り身だからこそ、俺を映画に誘った
のではなかったか。
dialogues.en:
When he invited me to the movies, he said that he was
unattached.
dialogues.text:
When he invited me to the movies, he said that he was
unattached.

dialogues.jp:
あんな必死な女の子に対して、嘘をついてまで
断るなんて……。
dialogues.en: To reject such a sweet, earnest girl by lying...
dialogues.text: To reject such a sweet, earnest girl by lying...

dialogues.jp: よっぽどの理由がないと納得できんぞ。
dialogues.en: That's completely incomprehensible by anyone's standards.
dialogues.text: That's completely incomprehensible by anyone's standards.

dialogues.jp:
それとも、俺と出かけたあの後から彼女をこし
らえたとでもいうのだろうか……。
dialogues.en: If I knew that that was going to happen to that girl...
dialogues.text: If I knew that that was going to happen to that girl...

dialogues.jp: ……それはそれでむかっと来るな。
dialogues.en: ...Then maybe I wouldn't have wanted to watch.
dialogues.text: ...Then maybe I wouldn't have wanted to watch.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……俺……今、好きな人がいるから」
dialogues.en: "... I... have someone I like right now."
dialogues.text: "... I... have someone I like right now."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺の問いに対し、工藤はすこし恥ずかし
そうにそう答えた。
dialogues.en: Kudou answered my accusation in a slightly embarassed tone.
dialogues.text: Kudou answered my accusation in a slightly embarassed tone.

dialogues.jp: ああ、なるほど、そういうことだったのか。
dialogues.en: Ahh, I see. So that's why he rejected her.
dialogues.text: Ahh, I see. So that's why he rejected her.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、それはしょうがない。
dialogues.en: In that case, it can't really be helped.
dialogues.text: In that case, it can't really be helped.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ふっと杉並の言葉を思い出し、尋ねてみ
る。
dialogues.en: Remembering Suginami's words before, I asked.
dialogues.text: Remembering Suginami's words before, I asked.

dialogues.jp:
「……ひょっとして……それって、ことりのこ
　とか？」
dialogues.en: "...That person... is it Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...That person... is it Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「は？　なんでそう思うんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Why did you think that?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Why did you think that?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤はきょとんとした顔で首をかしげた。過度
に否定するでもなく、もちろん肯定するでもな
く。
dialogues.en:
Kudou tilted his head in question. An answer that neither
confirmed nor denied anything.
dialogues.text:
Kudou tilted his head in question. An answer that neither
confirmed nor denied anything.

dialogues.jp: しらばっくれている、という印象はない。
dialogues.en: His innocence gave me the impression that it was wrong.
dialogues.text: His innocence gave me the impression that it was wrong.

dialogues.jp: どうやら本当に違うようだな……。
dialogues.en: I guess it probably is...
dialogues.text: I guess it probably is...

dialogues.jp:
「いや、別に……確か杉並がそんなこと言って
　たな、と思って…………」
dialogues.en:
"No, nothing... Suginami mentioned it before, so I
thought..."
dialogues.text:
"No, nothing... Suginami mentioned it before, so I
thought..."

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、工藤は苦笑を浮かべた。
dialogues.en: As I talked, Kudou laughed out loud.
dialogues.text: As I talked, Kudou laughed out loud.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「バカだな、あいつの与太に付き合ってたら身
　がもたねーぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Stupid, you should know that idiot treats every rumour as
gospel."
dialogues.text:
"Stupid, you should know that idiot treats every rumour as
gospel."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ま、確かに」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, you're right."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, you're right."

dialogues.jp:
それは俺も重々承知の上だ。でも、それじゃ、
好きな奴ってのは誰のことなんだろう？
dialogues.en:
That was something I definitely agreed with. But if that's
the case, then who's this person he likes?
dialogues.text:
That was something I definitely agreed with. But if that's
the case, then who's this person he likes?

dialogues.jp: 俺には、他に思い当たる節がないし……。
dialogues.en: I can't think of anyone else who might fit the bill...
dialogues.text: I can't think of anyone else who might fit the bill...

dialogues.jp:
「で……本当は誰が好きなんだ？　この際だか
　ら白状しろよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Then, who is it that you like? You should just confess
already."
dialogues.text:
"...Then, who is it that you like? You should just confess
already."

dialogues.jp: ヒジで突付かんばかりに問いただす。
dialogues.en: I elbowed him in the ribs as I asked.
dialogues.text: I elbowed him in the ribs as I asked.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Huh~~~~~? ....Yeah, I should......"
dialogues.text: "Huh~~~~~? ....Yeah, I should......"

dialogues.jp:
工藤はかすかに微笑を浮かべながらおもむろに
口を開いた。
dialogues.en:
A small smile creeped onto his face as he opened his mouth
again.
dialogues.text:
A small smile creeped onto his face as he opened his mouth
again.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「………………実を言えば俺が好きなのは……
　朝倉、お前だよ」
dialogues.en: "....The one I said that I liked... it's you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "....The one I said that I liked... it's you, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Wha!?"
dialogues.text: "Wha!?"

dialogues.jp:
ナンデスト？　俺ははじかれたように顔をあげ
て工藤をみつめた。
dialogues.en:
What the hell? My face flushed bright red as I looked at
him.
dialogues.text:
What the hell? My face flushed bright red as I looked at
him.

dialogues.jp: 誰が誰を誰でどうしたですって？
dialogues.en: Who likes who likes who now?
dialogues.text: Who likes who likes who now?

dialogues.jp: 俺の脳は事実確認をすべく高速回転していた。
dialogues.en:
My brain went into high-speed trying to figure out what
happened.
dialogues.text:
My brain went into high-speed trying to figure out what
happened.

dialogues.jp: 沈黙の時が流れる。
dialogues.en: Silence prevailed.
dialogues.text: Silence prevailed.

dialogues.jp:
………数秒後、我慢できない、というように、
工藤がふきだした。
dialogues.en:
...Several seconds after, not being able to keep it in
anymore, Kudou burst out in laughter.
dialogues.text:
...Several seconds after, not being able to keep it in
anymore, Kudou burst out in laughter.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ぷぷっ……その顔！　マジ信じか！？」
dialogues.en: "Mmmph.... that face! You really believed me!?"
dialogues.text: "Mmmph.... that face! You really believed me!?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、な……じょ、冗談……か？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, ah, wha... a... joke?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, ah, wha... a... joke?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ったり前だろ」
dialogues.en: "Obviously!"
dialogues.text: "Obviously!"

dialogues.jp: 馬鹿な奴だなと、面白そうに笑う工藤。
dialogues.en:
That idiot was smiling as if everything was right in the
world.
dialogues.text:
That idiot was smiling as if everything was right in the
world.

dialogues.jp: 「はあぁぁぁぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Haaaaaaaaaaah..."
dialogues.text: "Haaaaaaaaaaah..."

dialogues.jp:
全身から力が抜けていく。汗がどっと噴き出し
た。
dialogues.en:
A huge weight was finally lifted from my shoulders, with my
face sweating like crazy.
dialogues.text:
A huge weight was finally lifted from my shoulders, with my
face sweating like crazy.

dialogues.jp: 「……心臓に悪い冗談はよせ」
dialogues.en: "...Don't tell jokes that'd give me a heart attack."
dialogues.text: "...Don't tell jokes that'd give me a heart attack."

dialogues.jp: こめかみ押さえて俺は脱力した声をあげた。
dialogues.en: I rubbed my forehead and warned him exhaustedly.
dialogues.text: I rubbed my forehead and warned him exhaustedly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あはははははっ……ヒトのプライベートに立
　ち入ったことを｛き／訊｝くお前が悪い」
dialogues.en:
"Ahahahaha... it's your own fault for trying to meddle in
other people's private matters."
dialogues.text:
"Ahahahaha... it's your own fault for trying to meddle in
other people's private matters."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は「じゃあな」と俺に軽く手をあげると、
足早にどこかへ姿を消した。
dialogues.en:
Kudou then said "later", waved to me in goodbye, and walked
off quickly.
dialogues.text:
Kudou then said "later", waved to me in goodbye, and walked
off quickly.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、こら待て！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, hold it!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, hold it!"

dialogues.jp: 結局、肝心なことは、はぐらかしたまま……。
dialogues.en: In the end, I still didn't find out the important part...
dialogues.text: In the end, I still didn't find out the important part...

dialogues.jp: （……ば、ばかにしやがって）
dialogues.en: "(...That, that bastard.)"
dialogues.text: "(...That, that bastard.)"

dialogues.jp:
なにが俺のことが好きだ。……あんな真面目な
顔して言われたら、信じちまうじゃねーか。
dialogues.en:
That crap about liking me... saying it with such a serious
face, I really believed him...
dialogues.text:
That crap about liking me... saying it with such a serious
face, I really believed him...

dialogues.jp: 俺の守備範囲には、男なんぞ……。
dialogues.en: But, but we're guys after all...
dialogues.text: But, but we're guys after all...

dialogues.jp:
もわもわと、工藤の笑顔が幻の如く頭に付き纏
う。
dialogues.en: His smiling face as he confessed continued to haunt me.
dialogues.text: His smiling face as he confessed continued to haunt me.

dialogues.jp:
……そう、アイツ、女顔なんだよな。割と｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝
だし。
dialogues.en:
...Yeah, his face really looks like a girl's. It's quite
beautiful...
dialogues.text:
...Yeah, his face really looks like a girl's. It's quite
beautiful...

dialogues.jp: 「髪なんかもこう、サラサラでさ……」
dialogues.en: "And his hair was waving in the wind..."
dialogues.text: "And his hair was waving in the wind..."

dialogues.jp: 「マジか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me..."
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me..."

dialogues.jp: ◆好きな人は……◆
dialogues.en: ◆The loved one is...◆
dialogues.text: ◆The loved one is...◆

dialogues.jp:
学園からの帰り道、工藤が女子生徒からの告白
を断っている所を偶然目撃した。
dialogues.en:
While walking home from school, by chance, I stumbled upon a
female student confessing to Kudou.
dialogues.text:
While walking home from school, by chance, I stumbled upon a
female student confessing to Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
なんともったいないと、後で理由を問いただし
た所、工藤には好きな人がいるらしい。
dialogues.en:
He rejected her because, as he told me later, he has someone
he likes.
dialogues.text:
He rejected her because, as he told me later, he has someone
he likes.

dialogues.jp:
更に、しつこく聞いてみると、「実は朝倉のこ
とが好き」と答える工藤……。
dialogues.en:
He also said, at my continued questioning, that "The one I
like is Asakura"...
dialogues.text:
He also said, at my continued questioning, that "The one I
like is Asakura"...

dialogues.jp:
結局、からかわれただけだったのだが、何故か、
むしょうに、工藤の事が気になってしまう俺な
のだった。
dialogues.en:
Despite it obviously being a joke, after that incident, I
couldn't stop thinking about him...
dialogues.text:
Despite it obviously being a joke, after that incident, I
couldn't stop thinking about him...
